mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert (alert_id, severity, name, summary, host, status, source, metrics_json, labels_json, description, alert_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{alertId}, #{severity}, #{name}, #{summary}, #{host}, #{status}, #{source}, #{metricsJson}, #{labelsJson}, #{description}, #{alertTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_id, severity, name, summary, host, status, source, metrics_json, labels_json, description, alert_time, create_time, update_time FROM alert WHERE alert_id = #{alertId}

SELECT id, alert_id, severity, name, summary, host, status, source, metrics_json, labels_json, description, alert_time, create_time, update_time FROM alert WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'info' THEN 3 END, alert_time DESC

SELECT id, alert_id, severity, name, summary, host, status, source, metrics_json, labels_json, description, alert_time, create_time, update_time FROM alert WHERE severity = #{severity} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY alert_time DESC

SELECT id, alert_id, severity, name, summary, host, status, source, metrics_json, labels_json, description, alert_time, create_time, update_time FROM alert ORDER BY alert_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert WHERE severity = #{severity} AND status = 'active'
